description: List reusable FUNCTIONS in the connected project — the FN_* library of building blocks that test cases call as nested steps. NOT test cases: if the user asks for test cases, TCs, scenarios, or scripts, use `tc_list` instead. Trigger words for THIS tool: "functions", "reusable functions", "function library", "FN_", "shared steps", "building blocks". Returns id, key (FN_*), name, description, technology (WEB/API/ANDROID/IOS), execution type (MANUAL/AUTOMATION), review status, step count. Use `get_function` to read one in full (with its steps) and `delete_function` to soft-delete. SimplifyQA-only. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Read-only.

createdBy.description: Numeric userId of the creator. Pass "me" to filter by the current caller (needs QA_MCP_USER_ID for API-key auth). Resolve names to ids via list_users first.

fnType.description: Filter by technology (WEB / API / ANDROID / IOS).

moduleId.description: Only functions filed under this module (id or business key, e.g. MO_12).

search.description: Free-text search over the function name.

updatedBy.description: Numeric userId of the last updater. Pass "me" for the current caller. Resolve names via list_users first.

name: list_functions
title: List / search reusable functions (NOT test cases)
